preconditions.description: The input contains exactly t test cases, each consisting of 4 lines of coordinates, preceded by a single line containing t.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**9 and 0 <= y <= 10**9 for x, y in points)
preconditions.description: All coordinates x and y are integers within the range [0, 10^9].
The four input points in each test case are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(ans, int) and ans >= 0 for ans in answers)
postconditions.description: The output consists of t non-negative integers, one per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(min_steps(points) == ans for points, ans in zip(all_points_list, answers))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer equals the minimum total Manhattan distance required to move the four input points to form a square with sides parallel to the axes. This minimum is taken over all possible squares (defined by bottom-left corner (x, y) and side length s >= 0) and all possible bijections between the input points and the four vertices of the square.
